Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Bonbeach

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Bonbeach. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Bonbeach sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Bonbeach: What We Commonly See

Bonbeach is a narrow beachside strip between Carrum and Chelsea, and almost every home sits within easy reach of the sand. That close-to-the-water position means salt-laden air corrodes metal roofs, ridge capping fixings, valleys and gutters faster than inland. Many of its post-war and period homes now have roofs well past their best, alongside metal roofs showing rust.

The problems we see most in Bonbeach are rusted gutters and valleys, lifted and cracked ridge capping, roofs due for replacement, and leaks where corroded flashings have failed.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Bonbeach

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Bonbeach homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

Many older homes were built with roofs that contain asbestos cement sheeting. If that is your roof, we handle safe asbestos roof removal and replacement and finish the job in new COLORBOND® steel. We also convert older roofs to metal with our tile to tin service, and we will tell you honestly which option suits your home.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Bonbeach

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Bonbeach

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Bonbeach Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Bonbeach Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Bonbeach locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Bonbeach Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
